name: Resend
description: Resend is a platform designed to streamline and automate the process of resending emails, notifications, and other digital communications. It helps businesses ensure that important messages reach their intended recipients, even if the initial attempt fails. With Resend, users can manage and track their communication efforts efficiently, improving engagement and response rates.
